skill_name: Identify an example of a technology-enabled business model that could improve customer engagement.
workflow: An example of a technology-enabled business model that could improve customer engagement is subscription-based models. Subscription based models allow companies to offer their services on a regular, recurring payment schedule. This allows customers to easily budget for their services and provides steadier long-term stream of revenue for the company.
